verdict.rationale: Weaviate's quickstart documents official client libraries in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java, which directly delivers building against official SDKs. A community comment adds independent mention of running Weaviate as an embedded Python package. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK documentation (API reference, versioning/feature parity across languages), and hands-on corroboration of the official clients themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: install one of the official client libraries, available in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java.
You can even run Weaviate as an embedded python package rather than a separate process
